clue.text: Miley's arse all over "potassium-free" startled Becks – a painful thing

explanation.walkthrough: Miley Cyrus is American, hence the American spelling of the rude word; Becks is footballer David Beckham. The deletion happens before the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: An abscess is a swollen pocket of pus in body tissue, and these are notoriously sore.
